categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Layer 0 (L0)
categories.content: Layer 0 is the foundational infrastructure upon which multiple Layer 1 blockchains can be built.

categories.name: Optimism Superchain Ecosystem
categories.content: The Optimism Superchain is a unified network of chains built using the open-source OP Stack. This framework provides a standardized, modular architectural framework for creating Layer 2 chains that share a common security and communication layer.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: SocialFi
categories.content: SocialFi combines social media and DeFi. It aims to bring a more decentralized and user-centric approach to social media platforms, allowing users to monetize their interactions and content directly.

categories.name: Decentralized Identifier (DID)
categories.content: Decentralized Identifier (DID) allows individuals or entities to create and manage their own identifiers independently of any centralized registry, identity provider, or intermediary.

categories.name: DRC-20
categories.content: DRC-20 is a token standard on the Dogecoin blockchain that allows for the creation of tokens that represent ownership of assets.
